portable_recurrence_guards: Never represent case-distinct replacement tokens as keys in a PowerShell hashtable.
Require token-boundary or exact-literal review before any global name substitution.
Test literal-path existence before enumerating optional generated directories.
Refresh source context immediately before a dependent patch and avoid stale copied snippets.
On Windows, reserve wildcard matching for rg -g and keep path operands literal.
Treat PowerShell display decoding as presentation only; use rg UTF-8 matching or code-point-safe construction.
After one shell-literal encoding parse failure, change representation rather than repeat it.
Scope recursive scans to owner and lifecycle file families before increasing the time bound.
Never infer a reference filename from a neighboring skill; use the selected SKILL.md declarations.
Encode the Windows wildcard rule directly in lifecycle audit commands rather than relying on recollection.
Resolve each lifecycle allowlist before staging scaffolding shared with a later commit.
After a mutating wrapper timeout, inspect durable path and index state and never repeat the move blindly.
